decisions.reason: The polymer concrete drain housing had its own page in both observed years and is a low-cost component that fits the firm's compatible product families, so keeping the option open costs little.

The floor-level shower drainage system went from a mention in 2018 to its own page in 2019, a positive signal at the core of the firm's direction toward accessible bathrooms that justifies further commitment.
The designer flagship slipped from its own page to a mere mention, but design drains are central to the firm's positioning and the uncertainty is not resolved enough to abandon it.

The shower element with integrated slope has only been mentioned and its value is still unclear, but it complements the floor-level shower systems and is cheap to keep while the renovation trend unfolds.
The backflow-protected basement drain rose from its own page to the home page, and rising flood-protection demand signals strong value worth continued investment.
The air-admittance valve is a peripheral, low-visibility accessory with modest evidence, but its holding cost in a standard range is low, so the option is kept rather than abandoned.
